flavor:
Count Alaric is an ancient Vampire of such profound power that nature and reality are warped by his presence. Where he settles, nights grow unnaturally long, as though the sun is afraid to rise. Beasts become rabid and vicious, vermin reproduce until they fill the alleys. Before long, locals become despondent and hopeless as the Vampires he spawns run amok, and spread to nearby settlements. Once a region collapses under his influence, he will search for new hunting grounds.

Alaric is rarely seen outside his estate, preferring his Thralls to bring him entertainment. Although he presents the air of a handsome sophisticate, Alaric is emotional, passionate, and prone to flights of fancy. The subjects of his obsessions are carelessly discarded the moment something else catches his eye. As long as the Count remains alive, everyone in his domain is in peril. If the heroes lack sufficient motivation, a friendly NPC may go missing, last seen at his estate.

Bats: They may clump up near hero with high armor, or one with an AoE ability. Or they may move twice and instead of attacking.

Beckon. Use this less often, use Ebonfang more.
Monologue. Arrogant and perilously self-absorbed, he may underestimate the heroes and spend a turn or two taunting them, telling them of his plans or insulting them for their impudence. "You'd make lovely thralls…"
tactics.harder:
Bats: Alaric is far deadlier with his bat swarms. If they’re being shut down, spread them out.
Mobility: Outdistance melee heroes using Ebonfang, targeting the back line with Beguile and Beckon at every opportunity.

traits.text: Attack with advantage when unarmored.

tactics.harder: Use Stomp as often as possible, including against heroes Grappled by allies.

actions.text: (Cone 4) 4d8. Must spend an attack to reload after firing.

tactics.easier: Start combat needing to reload
tactics.harder: start combat loaded and ready to Fire!

tactics.harder: Move the heroes into clumps to set up big AoE attacks from Blasthands. And whip Blasthands to make them reload faster.

name: Brollachan

traits.name: Look-not-at-me
traits.text: Heroes can choose to close their eyes and be Blinded, otherwise you spend one of their actions each round.

flavor: A formless creature of shadow that covets the shape worn by others. It enters the eyes of fools who stare at it too long, taking possession of their form until their bodies succumb or their will is spent.

tactics.easier: Use the target’s action to attack higher armor Heroes.
tactics.harder: Use the target’s action to move them next to a stronger monster, like a Bogey, a Nixie in water, or to deal damage to a weaker Hero.

name: Bug
flavor: Wherever there is A bug—there are MORE BUGS nearby.

tactics.easier: Focus fire on heroes with high armor or near heroes with strong AoE abilities.
tactics.harder: Multiple small creatures can fit in a single space. Surrounding a hero with 10–20 minions can get deadly FAST (especially if they have low armor or no AoE abilities)!

name: Bugbear
flavor: Big, brutish, and permanently grumpy, Bugbears are the heavy muscle of Goblin society. They despise noise and disorder—Bugbears tolerate Goblins' antics in exchange for servitude and a steady supply of things to hit.

tactics.easier: Attack from Range or spread damage out. Attack first in a round while heroes can still Interpose & Defend.
tactics.harder: Bugbears are patient ambushers,they can start combat hidden, attacking any hero who has strayed too far from his party, or their back lines.

name: Bugbear (GM Guide)

actions.name: Bash
actions.text: (Reach 2) 3d6. On damage, target's next attack is disadvantaged. Or:

flavor: Green, cunning, & thriving on the edge of chaos. Will mock you mercilessly if given the chance.

name: Bugbear Chieftain

traits.name: I want results!
traits.text: Goblins gain +2 speed and advantage on attacks.

actions.name: Cleave
actions.text: (Reach 2) 2d6+10, can also damage a 2nd target within Reach.

flavor: Chieftains rule with fear, iron clubs, and a zero-tolerance policy for goblin antics (except the useful kind). Under their leadership, goblins become surprisingly efficient raiders—at least for a few weeks.

tactics.easier: Use cleave to also strike a goblin that is in your way.
tactics.harder: Target only heroes. Force a goblin to Interpose for you.

name: Bulette

traits.name: Burst Forth!
traits.text: Combat starts with the heaviest character making a DC 14 DEX save or they are Grappled and take 1d12+20 (half on save, escape DC 14).

actions.name: Drag Below
actions.text: (vs Grappled creature) 2d12 then drag below and burrow 6.

flavor: Stoneskinned ambush predators with shovel-shaped claws and a gaping maw. Their burrowing has been known to sink entire houses.

tactics.easier: Stay above ground, mostly using Leap & Bite.
tactics.harder: Drag Below as much as possible.

name: Bulette (GM Guide)

traits.name: Burst Forth!
traits.text: When the Bulette enters Combat, the heaviest creature is targeted with Leap & Bite.

actions.name: Drag Below
actions.text: (vs Grappled) 1d20+10 and burrow away (leaving a tunnel 2 spaces wide). Or:

flavor: Mighty brutes and cunning beasts, always on the lookout for easy prey.

traits.name: Serpentine Movements

actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d4. On crit: +20 damage and Poisoned until healed (except Dwarves & Hunters).

traits.name: Slipstream

actions.text: DC 20 WIL save or DOOMED: Concentration ends, the next damage roll against you is maximized.

tactics.harder: Maximize the distance you Charge each turn.

tactics.harder: Partner with Psionic Scourges or Despots. Rush in, Daze heroes, and use Seed Thought to move them towards your masters to finish off.

bloodied.text: Enemies within Reach 12 gain Thornblight. Gain: Petal Storm. (1 use, Reach 8, AoE) 2d10+10, half on a DC 13 DEX save.

lastStand.text: Florindris regains 23 HP per hero, and Aura of Wind and Gust move creatures twice as far.

traits.name: Bug Zap
traits.text: Vulnerable to lightning, adjacent creatures take 5 acid damage.

groupTraits.name: Something Feels… Off
groupTraits.text: Combat with ambush predators starts with a hero making a DC 15 Survival check. Another hero makes a DC 15 Perception check (with disadvantage, if the Survival check failed). If the Perception check fails, the monsters go first (heroes skip their first turn, but start combat with 3 actions)!

name: Forest Gnome

traits.name: Weeee!
traits.text: When Riding a creature, attacks are made against you with disadvantage, and any that miss you damage them.

flavor: Amongst the smallest of the forest residents, living peacefully in small communes alongside their critter friends. They do not tolerate rude guests, however.

tactics.easier: Leap off a target after 1 round.
tactics.harder: Ride and attack the same target as long as possible.

name: Forge Tyrant Drunzir
kind: Brimstone Smith and his Manticore Mount
actionsIntro: Mounted Combatant: After each hero's turn choose 1:

bloodied.name: Intimidating Roar
bloodied.text: (100 hp) Heroes cannot move this round on a failed DC 15 WIL save.

lastStand.text: At 0hp Drunzir's mount is slain. He loses flying, and gains Heavy armor. He cleaves off the manticore's stinger to wield as his weapon. After each hero's turn choose 1. Cruel Whip. Move 5, then (Reach 6) 2d6+6. On hit: pull 6 and Restrain (escape DC 15). OR: Venomous Stinger. D66 (with advantage is Restrained).

flavor: As sturdy and hot-tempered as the caverns that forged him. Among the harsh clanging of hammers, screech of chains, and blasts of steam, Drunzir rules his domain from the great forge under the mountains. All who dwell in the burghs of brimstone fear his cruelty.

traits.name: Icelord
traits.text: Vulnerable to Fire. (1/Round) Use Ice Tomb as a reaction when crit or dealt fire damage.

actions.name: Ice Tomb
actions.text: (Reach 8) Encase a creature in Ice (it has 10 hp, and vulnerable to bludgeoning/fire). Then:

actions.name: Twin Greataxes (2x)
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d12+10. On damage: Knockback 1. +10 damage to ice tombed creatures, shattering it.

bloodied.name: Avalanche
bloodied.text: (Reaction: at 65 HP) Restrain all heroes on a failed DC 16 DEX save, each suffers 20 damage minus their save result.

name: Fungal Hulk

traits.name: Siege Vehicle
traits.text: Up to 4 med creatures can fit atop and direct this creature's movement. They gain Cover and Medium armor. When destroyed creatures on it fall Prone.

flavor: Towering molds animated by mycelial growths, used as mindlesss pack animals and seige engines. These aren't true living creatures, but walking compost heaps. Grown from ritual burial of the dead in "spore pits."

name: Fungusfolk Psychotrope

traits.name: On Death: Hallucinatory Spores
traits.text: (Reach 2) Hallucinate.

actions.name: Headbutt
actions.text: 1d4. On hit, Hallucinate: the GM immediately spends an action for you, moving or making a basic attack.

flavor: Spiritual mushroom visionaries, Psychotropes motivate their communites to …

tactics.easier: Move heroes randomly or safely while Hallucinating.
tactics.harder: Stay close to Sentinels, make heroes retreat out of their reach while Hallucinating, or into other hazards.

name: Fungusfolk Sentinel

traits.name: Hazardous Ground
traits.text: (Reach 6) Enemies suffer 1 damage/space moved in this area.

traits.name: On Death: Calming Spores
traits.text: (Reach 2) Daze.

actions.name: Enticing Spores
actions.text: (Reach 6) 1d4. On hit, spend 1 action moving toward you +1 damage/space moved.

flavor: Peacekeepers in fungus communes, their psychic connection to the earth warns and defends against threats.

tactics.easier: Don’t retreat. Target heroes adjacent to you and don't spend their action moving.
tactics.harder: Continually withdraw to advantageous terrain. Force heroes to take damage pursuing.

name: Fungusfolk Sovereign

traits.name: Mycelial Network
traits.text: (Reach 100) Fungus folk gain advantage on attacks.

actions.name: Sovereign Command
actions.text: Trigger the On Death effect of an ally. Then:

flavor: The eldest Fungusfolk share their wisdom telepathically, turning their peers into efficient warriors.

tactics.easier: Command a Sentinal to wast its Daze on an already Dazed hero, make a hero without any actions hallucinate.
tactics.harder: Stay out of reach and command from cover or even a completely different cave system!

name: Gargoyle
flavor: Stone statues of terrifying design, imbued with a mote of a vampire's magical essence. Used by vampires to protect their castle homes, they attack by flying above enemies and crushing them with terrible force.

name: General Flameheart

traits.name: Cinder Armor
traits.text: Resistant to fire. When damaged, deal 5 fire damage to all adjacent creatures.

traits.name: Extinguish Flame
traits.text: Cold or radiant crits extinguish all areas ignited by Molten Fury and suppress Cinder Armor until the end of the next hero's turn.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one (rec. alternate):

actions.name: Inferno Cleave
actions.text: Move 6 then strike a 3×2 square area for 2d10+10 fire damage.

actions.name: Molten Fury
actions.text: Lob a molten fireball at the furthest hero not already in the flames, igniting a 2×2 square area. Creatures there take 2d10+10 damage; and another 10 damage at the end of each of their turns if they remain in the area.

bloodied.name: Flamespawn
bloodied.text: Each Molten Fury spawns an Elemental Fireling minion.

lastStand.text: Flameheart regains 19 HP per hero, his attacks increase to a 3×3 area. Spawn a Fireling on each of his turns.

name: Ghost

traits.name: Start of Combat: Possess
traits.text: All heroes make a WIL save, the lowest is Possessed: Gain 1 action that only the Ghost can spend at will. The Ghost also takes damage whenever the hero does, and whenever they are healed.

flavor: Those with unfinished business in the mortal realm. Sometimes friendly, sometimes fearsome.

tactics.easier: Move the possessed hero, or make basic attacks. Allow the party to RP with you, and be convinced to act on their behalf.
tactics.harder: Use reactions so the possessed hero can’t. Interpose for monsters, negating an ally’s attack.

name: Ghoul

traits.name: Unliving, Undying
traits.text: (1 use) On death: reset to 1 HP.

flavor: Ghouls have remembered only one thing from life: hunger.

tactics.easier: Act first, targeting already Dazed heroes or ones who have not yet Defended this round.
tactics.harder: Act last, targeting heroes who are Grappled, Prone, or not already Dazed.

name: Ghoul (GM Guide)

traits.name: Unliving, Undying
traits.text: (1 use) On death, reset to 1 HP.

flavor: Hate the living for not being dead, hate themselves for having died.

name: Giant Bug

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

flavor: Many giant bug species are able to eat anything and live anywhere—infesting caves, wildernesses, and even urban environs.

tactics.easier: Stay in melee reach or clump together with other bugs.
tactics.harder: Move out of melee reach after attacking; summon minions in places that block movement and obstruct heroes' plans.

name: Giant Cobra (GM Guide)

traits.name: Coiling Strike
traits.text: On melee crit, Grapple (escape DC 10).

flavor: *Aggressive Hissing noises*

traits.name: Diapause
traits.text: Vulnerable to cold damage, advantage on next attack.

traits.name: Grappling
traits.text: If Grappling a creature with both claws, gain advantage 2 on attacks. Each claw must be escaped idividually to end the Grapple.

groupTraits.text: Combat with ambush predators starts with a hero making a DC 15 Survival check. Another hero makes a DC 15 Perception check (with disadvantage, if the Survival check failed). If the Perception check fails, the monsters go first (heroes skip their first turn, but start combat with 3 actions)!

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

traits.name: Discordant Song
traits.text: Enemies who can hear make an INT save instead of rolling Initiative. The first creature heroes target each round is chosen at random.

name: Giant Spider

actions.name: Shoot Web
actions.text: (Range 6) 1d8+2, Restrained (escape DC 12, or any slashing/fire damage). OR:

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (vs Hampered target) 2d8+4. On damage, Poisoned (healing ends).

flavor: With webs strong as steel cables, these arachnids have grown to absurd proportions to compete with other creatures of the deep for food.

tactics.easier: Web up targets from a distance and and move in one by one. Let heroes target you one at a time.
tactics.harder: Use traps or terrain for cover as you shoot web, have allies Hamper weak heroes and immediately bite!

name: Giant Spider (GM Guide)

actions.name: Shoot Web
actions.text: (Range 6) 1d8+2, Restrained (escape DC 12, or any slashing/fire damage). Or:

flavor: Nightmarish denizens of the deep, these monstrous beings lurk in dark tunnels and cavernous depths, ready to ensnare or devour any intruders.

name: Giant Venus Flytrap

traits.name: Vengeful Plant
traits.text: Also acts whenever a Seedling dies.

actionsIntro: Choose 1:

actions.name: Tangle
actions.text: (Reach 12, up to 2 different targets) 1d6+2, Grappled (escape DC 12, or any fire or slashing damage).

actions.name: Reel In
actions.text: (If Grappling) pull target adjacent, then Bite.

groupTraits.name: Unyielding Stalkers
groupTraits.text: Heroes roll a STR save instead of Initiative.

traits.name: Unliving, Undying
traits.text: (1 use) On death: reset to 1 HP.

actions.name: Decaying Swipe (2×)
actions.text: 1d4+10. On damage: knockback Primary Die spaces.

tactics.easier: Target ranged heroes in the open to minimize the negative effects of Knockback.
tactics.harder: Target melee heroes near walls or their allies.

name: Giant Zombie (GM Guide)

traits.name: Unliving, Undying
traits.text: (1 use) On death, reset to 1 HP.

actions.name: Decaying Swipe (2×)
actions.text: 1d4+10. On damage, Prone or Knockback Primary Die spaces.

flavor: Hate the living for not being dead, hate themselves for having died.

traits.name: Reality Warping Utterings!
traits.text: Enemies begin combat Confused: their attacks are made with disadvantage. The GM chooses a new target for attacks that miss (ignoring range limitations).

actions.name: Gnashing Teeth, Blinding Spittle
actions.text: (Reach ANY) 1d4+10. On miss, Blinded. On crit, swap places with another creature.

tactics.easier: Choose another enemy to be struck, or choose randomly.
tactics.harder: Force heroes to attack allies or self when confused.

name: Glabrezu

actions.name: Doomclaw (2×)
actions.text: (Reach 2) 3d6+10. On damage: Grappled (escape DC 17; if Grappled by both claws, a creatures must escape from each of them). OR:

actions.name: Tear Asunder
actions.text: (A creature Grappled by both of the glabrezu's claws) 50 unpreventable damage. Then, if the target is Dying: DC 17 STR save or be torn in two, dying instantly.

flavor: A mighty fiend with terrible pincers and heavy carapace.

tactics.easier: Target two different heroes with Doomclaw.
tactics.harder: Target a single weak/slow hero with both Doomclaws.

name: Glabrezu (GM Guide)

actions.name: Doomclaw (2×)
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d6+20. On damage, Grappled (escape DC 16; if Grappled by both claws, must escape from each). Or:

actions.name: Tear Asunder
actions.text: (A creature Grappled by both claws) 50 unpreventable damage. Then, if the target is Dying: DC 16 STR save or be torn in two, dying instantly.

flavor: Driven by twisted beliefs, fanatical cultists perform dark rituals to awaken ancient evils, unleashing horrors that feast on fear and despair.

name: Gloom Moth

traits.name: Light-Absorbing Wings
traits.text: Radius of light & sound halved.

traits.name: Gloom Dust
traits.text: (Reach 6) Troglodytes roll d12s instead of d6s. When damaged, deal 1d12 unblockable psychic damage to enemies.

flavor: Swollen Ones raise these massive house-sized moths for use in foul ceremonies and to aid on the battlefield. Their wings absorb light and mask the sound of the Troglodyte tunneling. If threatened, they shed blinding dust that causes migraines and vomiting.

tactics.harder: Always remains airborne, out of reach of melee attacks. They are particularly nasty with Champions—changing EACH of their d6s to d12s! Ranged attacks are also much more difficult to land due to the lower light radius, heroes will need to figure out a way to better light the battlefield, or possibly use wind attacks to push the Gloommoth away! Any effect that depends on sound (e.g., Commander's Orders, Songweaver's Inspiration & Vicious Mockery) is likewise limited.

name: Gloomwing the Cruel

traits.name: Aura of Rot
traits.text: (Reach 6) enemies suffer 5 necrotic damage at the end of their turns.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Radiant damage suppresses Aura of Rot until the end of the next hero's turn.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one:

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Move 6, then (Reach 2) 2d10+10. On damage, Cruelty's Gift.

actions.name: Cruelty's Gift
actions.text: Healing is halved and Vulnerable to necrotic damage. Healing ends.

bloodied.text: Gain: Rot Breath (1 use). Fly 10, then (Cone 8, AoE) DC 17 DEX save or 8d10 necrotic, half on save.

lastStand.text: Gloomwing regains 30 HP per hero, Light Sensitivity ends, and the damage and Reach of Aura of Rot is doubled.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

name: Gnoll (GM Guide)

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage vs damaged creatures.

flavor: Mighty brutes and cunning beasts, always on the lookout for easy prey.

name: Gnoll Battle Shaman

traits.name: Battle Rattle
traits.text: All gnolls gain +2 speed and advantage while damaged.

actions.name: Baleful Howl
actions.text: DC 14 WIL save or Frightened 1 round. THEN:

actions.name: Withering Dread
actions.text: (Reach 10) 6d6 necrotic damage, divide these dice up amongst targets within reach.

flavor: A beacon of fear with an aptitude for unstable magic.

tactics.easier: Focus the Dread dice on 1 well-armored target.
tactics.harder: Whichever dice roll low on Withering Dread, damage unharmed allies. Spread the remaining dice out to make defending unappealing.

name: Gnoll Frenzied One

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

traits.name: Frenzy
traits.text: Advantage when damaged.

flavor: Flurry of chaos with no thought for self-preservation.

tactics.easier: Target well-armored or undamaged heroes. Have them ignore the Packleader's commands.
tactics.harder: Bloodthirsty and Frenzy can stack, giving Advantage 2.

name: Gnoll Hunter

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

flavor: A natural tracker that never loses a trail and never forgets a scent.

tactics.easier: Mostly use melee attacks, attack undamaged heroes.
tactics.harder: Use ranged attacks to damage multiple targets.

name: Gnoll Packleader

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

flavor: The first to taste blood in any battle, the Packleader drives his allies to victory.

tactics.easier: Bark Orders to move Gnolls adjacent to heroes after the gnoll has already attacked.
tactics.harder: Bark Orders to move Gnolls to safety after they’ve acted, or to give them extra movement needed to chase down heroes hiding behind the frontliners.

name: Gnoll Packleader (GM Guide)

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage vs damaged creatures.

flavor: Mighty brutes and cunning beasts, always on the lookout for easy prey.

traits.name: Deepsight
traits.text: When combat begins, roll 1d4 and 1d12. You may replace ANY die rolled with one of the values. Reroll them at the end of your turn.

groupTraits.name: Eye HATE you!
groupTraits.text: When crit with Piercing or Slashing, attacker rolls 1d20 instead of any other dice. Immediately use 1 ray.

name: Goblin

traits.name: Haha, Missed Me!
traits.text: Whenever an attack misses you, deal 2 psychic damage (ignoring armor).

flavor: The backbone of any raiding party, especially when it comes to setting up makeshift traps, stealing food, and heckling anything with a pulse.

tactics.easier: Very injured Goblins can run past multiple heroes, and less injured Goblins can remain adjacent to melee heroes rather than running away to same them an action moving.
tactics.harder: If a hero is within Reach 6, run up to them, stab, then run away in hopes of triggering an Opportunity Attack. Goad heroes into it with verbal taunts: "You can't catch me!" feigning fear (especially if you miss, or seeing them survive your best stab) "Ahh! Run awaayy!"

name: Goblin (GM Guide)

traits.name: Haha, Didn't Hurt!
traits.text: Whenever you survive an attack, deal 2 psychic damage back (ignoring Defense).

flavor: Green, cunning, & thriving on the edge of chaos. Will mock you mercilessly if given the chance.

name: Goblin Minion

traits.name: Haha, Missed Me!
traits.text: Whenever an attack misses you, deal 2 psychic damage (ignoring armor).

flavor: The cannon fodder of goblin society: lazy, sneaky, and only slightly more threatening than a thrown boot. Their job? Get in the way, hurl insults, and die hilariously.

name: Goblin Minion (GM Guide)

traits.name: Haha, Missed Me!
traits.text: Whenever you survive an attack, deal 2 psychic damage back (ignoring Defense).

flavor: Green, cunning, & thriving on the edge of chaos. Will mock you mercilessly if given the chance.

name: Goblin Ratrider

traits.name: Haha, Missed Me!
traits.text: Whenever an attack misses you, deal 2 psychic damage (ignoring armor).

traits.name: CHAAARGE!
traits.text: If you move at least 4 spaces in a straight line, attack with advantage once.

flavor: Riding into battle atop mangy giant rats, these goblins are thrill-seekers and scouts. Their mounts are as diseased and unpredictable as their riders.

tactics.easier: Can stay more stationary or spread their damage around, don't attack Prone targets.
tactics.harder: Hunt down backline and isolated heroes. Stay out of reach of melee heroes, set up powerful attacks for Bugbears when they knock Heroes Prone.

name: Goblin Ratrider (GM Guide)

traits.name: Haha, Nice Try!
traits.text: Whenever you survive an attack, deal 2 psychic damage back (ignoring Defense).

traits.name: CHAAARGE!
traits.text: If you move at least 4 spaces in a straight line, your next attack is advantaged.

flavor: Green, cunning, & thriving on the edge of chaos. Will mock you mercilessly if given the chance.

name: Goblin Taskmaster

traits.name: Haha, Missed Me!
traits.text: Whenever an attack misses you, deal 2 psychic damage (ignoring armor).

traits.name: Meat Shield
traits.text: Can force other goblins to Interpose for him.

actions.name: Get in here!
actions.text: Call a goblin minion to the fight.

flavor: Mean enough to boss other goblins around and survive the attempt. They often work under the heel of Bugbears, screaming secondhand orders and threats they usually can't deliver on.

tactics.easier: May "run out" of minions to call to the battlefield or their minions may be out of position to Interpose for them.
tactics.harder: Keep a minion within Interpose range at all times!

name: Goblin Taskmaster (GM Guide)

traits.name: Gotta Do Better Than That!
traits.text: Whenever you survive an attack, deal 2 psychic damage back (ignoring Defense).

traits.name: Meat Shield
traits.text: Can force other Goblins to Interpose for you.

actions.name: Get In Here!
actions.text: Call a Goblin Minion to the fight.

flavor: Green, cunning, & thriving on the edge of chaos. Will mock you mercilessly if given the chance.

tactics.easier: Clump up and attack heavily armored or high-health heroes that can easily shrug off their meager damage.
tactics.harder: Spread out and attack Dying heroes to inflict Wounds more quickly.

name: Grave Squire

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.text: Can Interpose for knights.

flavor: Fervently devoted servants of the dark.

tactics.easier: Clump up, and Interpose against small attacks, or push Knights into disadvantageous positions when Interposing.
tactics.harder: Spread out to avoid AoE damage, Interpose only against attacks that would bypass a Knight’s Armor or other above average attacks.

name: Gray Ooze

traits.name: Goopy 2
traits.text: When crit or dealt slashing damage: summon 2 ooze minions.

traits.name: Digested
traits.text: Deal an additional 2 damage for each time the target has been Digested this encounter.

flavor: Gray oozes are mindless puddles of corrosive goop, attracted by noise and light. Darkened by accumulated soot. Suspiciously clean hallways are left in their wake.

tactics.easier: Oozes often move very slowly or can easily become distracted by detritus in the dungeon.
tactics.harder: Oozes can be particularly nasty when falling from above, against heroes with slashing attacks, pit traps, or slashing traps.

name: Gray Ooze (GM Guide)

traits.name: Goopy 2
traits.text: (1/round) When crit or dealt slashing damage: summon 2 ooze minions.

actions.name: Digested
actions.text: Deal an additional 2 damage for each time the target has been Digested already this encounter.

flavor: For some creatures, YOU are the loot at the end of the dungeon.

name: Great Worm

traits.name: Tremor Sight
traits.text: Advantage vs any who moved this round.

traits.name: Swallowed
traits.text: You take 20 damage at the start of your turn. Your attacks cannot miss and ignore armor.

groupTraits.name: Eyeless Sight
groupTraits.text: Can see in the dark.

actions.name: Crush
actions.text: (2×6 adjacent area) d88 damage on a failed DC 18 DEX save. (Creatures who fail can spend 1 Action to dive out of the way instead of taking this damage. They move half their speed and land Prone.) OR:

flavor: Great Worms grind rocks to dust. They crawl deep below the crust of the world, eating anything that moves. Justifiably feared by all underground.

tactics.easier: Gorge yourself! Once most heroes are swallowed, your HP will melt away.
tactics.harder: Swallow only targets that can easily bypass your armor anyway, then use Crush to slow down their friends’ actions.

name: Great Worm (GM Guide)

traits.name: Tremor Sight
traits.text: Advantage vs targets who moved this round, Disadvantage otherwise.

actions.name: Crush
actions.text: (Line 3×6, AoE) d88 damage on a failed DC 18 DEX save. (Creatures who fail can spend 1 Action to dive out of the way instead of taking this damage. They move half their speed and land Prone.) Or:

actions.name: Swallowed
actions.text: You take 20 damage at the start of your turn. Your attacks cannot miss and ignore armor.

flavor: Nightmarish denizens of the deep, these monstrous beings lurk in dark tunnels and cavernous depths, ready to ensnare or devour any intruders.

name: Greater Dryad

groupTraits.name: Treebonded
groupTraits.text: Each Dryad is bonded to 1 specific tree, they only take damage when it does.

groupTraits.name: Treestep
groupTraits.text: Dryads inhabit trees and can teleport between any trees they can see.

groupTraits.name: Dryad Magic
groupTraits.text: Sum the attack dice, it gains the following effect: 2–3. Branch Sweep. Prone. 4–6. Rootlash. Restrained (Escape DC 10+dryad lvl, or any slashing damage). 7–8. Befuddled. Your next attack MUST be against an ally. 9-10. Thornburst. Teleport up to 6 away, then (Reach 2) 3d6 damage to allies. 11+. Glamorized. The next 2 actions you spend are controlled by the GM (you regain the spent actions afterward).

actions.name: Dryad Magic
actions.text: (Reach 8) 2d6+10. Gain an additional Dryad Magic effect based on the roll.

flavor: Captivating and charming…

tactics.easier: Stay within your home tree, even after it is attacked.
tactics.harder: Immediately teleport to another tree within sight after your bonded tree is attacked. Distract them by attacking from a non-bonded tree.

name: Greater Stirge

traits.name: Evasive Flier
traits.text: Attack against you are disadvantaged.

traits.name: Latched On
traits.text: You move where your target moves until either dies. Your attacks can’t miss or be Defended/Interposed against. Attacks that miss you damage your target instead.

flavor: The queens of a Stirge swarm are larger, more intelligent, and more aggressive than their peers. They will lead a swarm for hours, waiting for a moment when their prey is weakened or distracted to strike.

tactics.easier: Delatch after a round or two.
tactics.harder: Attack heroes with high Defense, combos well with creatures who Poison, Blind, or otherwise give additional Disadvantage.

name: Greater Stirge (GM Guide)

traits.name: Evasive Flier
traits.text: Attacks against you are disadvantaged.

actions.name: Latch On
actions.text: 1d12+10. On hit, Latched On: Riding; your attacks can't miss or be Defended/Interposed.

flavor: For some creatures, YOU are the loot at the end of the dungeon.

name: Green Hag

traits.name: Naughty Child!
traits.text: When Crit, ignore damage from exploding dice, deal that much damage back.

traits.name: Hobbled
traits.text: Half speed, ALL Reactions cost +1 action.

bloodied.text: (40 hp). Bitter Curse. Heroes are Hobbled on a failed DC 13 WIL save.

flavor: In swamps they wallow in secrets and schemes, practicing obscure and unknown magics. They are proud of their cunning and trick mortals into dooming themselves willingly.

name: Greenthumb, Lichling
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one (rec. alternate):

actions.name: Briarmancy
actions.text: Move 4. Summon 1 plant minion/hero (each moves and attacks for 1d4 damage at the end of every round).

bloodied.name: Thorny Roots
bloodied.text: All heroes make DC 11 DEX save or suffer 2d4 damage and Restrained; half damage on a save (escape: DC 11 STR or DEX, or any slashing or radiant damage).

lastStand.name: Barkskin
lastStand.text: Greenthumb regains 10 HP per hero and Heavy Armor. Being hit degrades the armor (H » M » None). He can also choose twice each turn.

name: Gremlin

traits.name: Come Get Some!
traits.text: If no heroes are Taunted, you may Taunt ALL heroes for 1 Round.

flavor: Diminutive troublemakers with a craving for chaos and disorder. No two gremlins are alike, their patterns of fur and horns as varied as the targets of their vexation.

tactics.easier: Taunt melee heroes that are near you.
tactics.harder: Taunt with a Gremlin that is further away or behind cover and not riding a hero; this makes all attacks against riding Gremlins made with disadvantage and more likely to hit the hero they're riding!

actions.name: Bully
actions.text: 1d6 (1d8 instead vs a Blinded or Ridden target).

name: Gremlin Roastmaster

traits.name: Take a look at this tough guy!
traits.text: (Reach 6) Heroes that miss attacks suffer 5 psychic damage.

flavor: Gremlins notorious enough to lead their own gang of bullies through insults and intimidation. Always on the lookout for new victims to strengthen their vile reputation.

tactics.easier: Limit "Take a look at this tough guy!" to 1/round.
tactics.harder: Stay near the heroes that are attacking taunting Gremlins to activate “Take a look at this tough guy!” as often as possible. Focus your Cheap Shots on heroes that are being hampered by Wrestlers.

name: Gremlin Wrestler

traits.name: Come Get Some!
traits.text: If no heroes are Taunted, you may Taunt all heroes for 1 Round.

traits.name: Punching Up
traits.text: Can Grapple Med/Large creatures.

actions.name: I’mma Mess You Up!
actions.text: 2d6+10. On hit: Grappled (escape DC 12). If Grappled, knock Prone as well.

flavor: Nasty bullies who immobilize much larger opponents with a mix of innate physical strength and fey magic.

tactics.easier: Switch from hero to hero, abstain from knocking Prone.
tactics.harder: Focus on one hero, knock Prone as much as possible. Always Taunt with the highest HP gremlin to protect those who are lower on HP.

name: Grick

groupTraits.name: Eyeless Sight
groupTraits.text: Can see in the dark.

actions.name: Grasping Tentacles
actions.text: 2d4 with advantage. Grappled (escape DC 14, or when crit). OR:

flavor: A man-sized worm sporting thick leathery skin and a tentacle-laden beak. Flexible tunnellers and capable ambushers.

tactics.easier: Grasp martial heroes with tentacles—but save the beak only for those that can take it.
tactics.harder: Swarm targets with Wormlets to set up powerful beak attacks for their bigger kin. Wormlets may be easy to escape, but it still takes an action!

name: Grick Alpha

groupTraits.name: Eyeless Sight
groupTraits.text: Can see in the dark.

actions.name: Grasping Tentacles
actions.text: (Reach 2) 2d4+10 with advantage. Grappled (escape DC 14, or when crit). OR:

flavor: When plentiful food is available, they grow additional tentacles and thick layers of muscle, bulking their body. Wormlets always follow, hoping for scraps the Alpha leaves behind.

tactics.easier: Grasp martial heroes with tentacles—but save the beak only for those that can take it.
tactics.harder: Swarm targets with Wormlets to set up powerful beak attacks for their bigger kin. Wormlets may be easy to escape, but it still takes an action!

name: Grick Wormlet

groupTraits.name: Eyeless Sight
groupTraits.text: Can see in the dark.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.text: 1d4, if 2 or more wormlets hit a single creature, Grapple (escape DC 4).

flavor: Juvenile Gricks haven’t developed their predatory instincts, but will lash out blindly at any creature it doesn’t recognize.

tactics.easier: Grasp martial heroes with tentacles—but save the beak only for those that can take it.
tactics.harder: Swarm targets with Wormlets to set up powerful beak attacks for their bigger kin. Wormlets may be easy to escape, but it still takes an action!

name: Griffon

actions.name: Fly & Drop
actions.text: (if Grappling) Fly upward 12 and release (6d6 fall damage, landing Prone).

flavor: Half-eagle, half-lion, and utterly majestic. Only reveals itself when finished with self-grooming.

tactics.easier: Stay low to the ground, and mostly use Talons.
tactics.harder: End turn in the air to avoid melee attacks. Use Fly & Drop as much as possible.

name: Griffon (GM Guide)

actions.name: Fly & Drop
actions.text: (if Grappling) Fly upward 12 and release (6d6 fall damage, landing Prone).

flavor: Mighty brutes and cunning beasts, always on the lookout for easy prey.

name: Grimbeak, the Unyielding

traits.name: Brutal
traits.text: Treat the highest die rolled as the Primary Die. On crit, knock Prone.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one (rec. alternate):

bloodied.text: Gain: Savage Screech. (1 use, Reach 12, AoE) 2d6 psychic damage (ignoring Defense). DC 11 WIL save or Frightened 1 round.

lastStand.text: Grimbeak regains 10 HP per hero and rolls d10s instead of d6s.

name: Grumbulus

traits.name: I Offer You SECRETS!
traits.text: (1 use) When an attacker would kill you: offer control of a random Fiend on their next turn. If accepted, you can't be harmed this round.

groupTraits.name: Fiendishly Crafty
groupTraits.text: A crafty fiend reveals only the benefits of the Offer and NOT the drawbacks—though if a hero insists, you may reveal all the terms.

flavor: Blackmailing, little secret-hoarders. They leverage this illicit information to hold sway over other fiends.

tactics.easier: Make your Offer more often (e.g., when you take damage), or select a powerful Fiend instead of choosing randomly.
tactics.harder: Use these with other powerful Fiends to really tempt Heroes into taking the offer—or with ones that summon weak minions like the Lumbrax to increase the chances of the heroes getting a bad deal!

name: Guard

traits.name: Keepers of Peace
traits.text: Will arrest rather than killing foes.

flavor: Low-skilled watchmen. Their primary job is to alert other (more capable) people to come when needed.

name: Halberdier Scion

traits.name: On Death
traits.text: 1 enemy gains advantage on their next attack.

groupTraits.name: Mana Charged
groupTraits.text: After mana is spent, the closest mana construct MUST attack a target within Range/Reach.

actions.name: Execute
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d20, advantage at Reach 2, disadvantage otherwise. On 18+: Prone.

flavor: Common infantry construct. These scions control space with their long polearms, and are deployed in corridors, temple gates, and narrow halls—anywhere they may face groups of enemies.

name: Hallway Mimic

traits.name: Perfectly Normal Hallway…
traits.text: Appears as a trivial-to-jump pit initially, as heroes attempt to cross, roll Initiative! Pull the hero who rolled the lowest into the Pit and Bite!

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.text: Deal +2x LVL damage on your first attack.

traits.name: Escape!
traits.text: Heroes can attempt to escape the Pit any way that makes sense. Spending an action to pull others out (must go Prone to reach them without rope), teleporting, flying, jumping, or any appropriate skill check (DC 10+1/2 lvl) rolled with disadvantage since the mimic is STICKY!

groupTraits.name: Ambusher
groupTraits.text: Mimics always start combat first and enemies roll Initiative with disadvantage.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, pull a Grappled hero 4 spaces then choose one:

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: (Reach 12) 1d6+LVL damage. On hit: Grappled (escape DC 10+1/2 LVL).

bloodied.name: Swinging Blades
bloodied.text: At half HP, trigger swinging blades on each side above the Pit. Any creature adjacent to the Pit (being pulled in or climbing out) suffers LVL damage on a failed DEX save.

lastStand.text: At 0 hp, the Mimic is dying! 10xLVL more damage and it dies. Until then the floor on both sides of the Pit slopes downward, before each hero's turn, move them 3 spaces nearer the Pit!

traits.name: Skittish
traits.text: When an ally Interposes, a harpie's attack misses.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.text: (Reach 8) 1d4+6 (can't be Interposed). On hit, move the target 2 spaces closer. OR:

traits.name: Skittish
traits.text: When an ally Interposes, a harpie's attack misses.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.text: (Reach 8) 1d4+6 (can't be Interposed). On hit, move the target 3 spaces closer. OR:

tactics.easier: Harpies need to have heroes separated enough to attack effectively.
tactics.harder: Lure heroes off a cliff >:D

traits.name: Bramble Marked
traits.text: Attackers take 5 damage.

actions.name: Hedge Curse
actions.text: 1d4, Cursed 30 (the next time you take damage this round, it deals +30 damage).

tactics.easier: Use Hedge Curse on a hero that is unlikely to get attacked again, or act last in the round.
tactics.harder: Act first, so that an ally attacks your cursed target immediately.

traits.name: Bramble Marked
traits.text: Attackers take 2 damage.

actions.name: Hedge Curse
actions.text: 1d4 Cursed 10 (the next time you take damage this round, it deals +10 damage).

tactics.harder: Act first, so that an ally attacks your cursed target immediately.

traits.name: Bramble Marked
traits.text: Attackers take 3 damage.

tactics.harder: Act first, so that an ally attacks your cursed target immediately.

actions.text: 1d4, Cursed 20 (the next time you take damage this round, it deals +20 damage).

tactics.easier: Use Hedge Curse on a hero that is unlikely to get attacked again, or act last in the round.
tactics.harder: Act first, so that an ally attacks your cursed target immediately.

name: Heytet-Seqat, Scorpion Queen

traits.name: Trampling Movement
traits.text: Can move through spaces of smaller creatures, knocking them Prone.

traits.name: Soft Underbelly
traits.text: Hits from Prone melee attackers automatically crit her.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, move 6 then choose 1:

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: 1d6+6. On damage, Grappled (escape DC 13, or when she is crit).

bloodied.text: She drips acid blood, dealing 1d6 damage to any creature she walks over.

name: Hezrou

traits.name: Consumed
traits.text: At the end of each of your turns suffer 2d6+6 damage (ignoring armor) and 1 Wound. Your attacks have advantage and ignore armor (teleport or escape DC 15).

flavor: A nightmarish toad-fiend, able to swallow a horse whole.

tactics.easier: Move twice instead of one of your attacks. Target high-STR/DEX classes to be consumed.
tactics.harder: Target classes that buff their allies (e.g., Commander, Songweaver) to limit their special abilities.

name: Hierarch

traits.name: Tip the Scales
traits.text: Enemies roll Disadvantage, with +1 Disadvantage. Allies roll Advantage with +1 Advantage.

groupTraits.name: Fiendishly Crafty
groupTraits.text: A crafty fiend reveals only the benefits of the Offer and NOT the drawbacks—though if a hero insists, you may reveal all the terms.

actions.name: I Offer You ABSOLUTION!
actions.text: (Reach 8) Permit 1 hero to kneel (considered Prone). Otherwise punish them for 2d20+10 damage.

flavor: High-Judges of Fiendlaw, ever tips the scales in their own favor.

tactics.easier: Act last amongst monsters or Offer Absolution to those not at risk of being attacked.
tactics.harder: Act first and Offer Absolution to those at greatest risk of being attacked.

traits.name: Touch Not the Flamecaller!
traits.text: When damaged, choose 1 Orc to move and trigger their Enrage ability.

groupTraits.name: Battlelust
groupTraits.text: Heroes have disadvantage on Initiative against an Orcish band.

groupTraits.name: Tough as Nails
groupTraits.text: Orcs have Medium armor, except against magic damage.

actions.name: Pillar of Flame
actions.text: (AoE, Reach 8) 1d10+10 to ALL creatures in a 2×2 area. Orcs there trigger their Enrage ability.

tactics.easier: Catch other orcs in Pillar of Flame.
tactics.harder: Stay near heroes that deal small amounts of damage frequently to get more out of your special ability.

name: Hill Giant

traits.name: Clumsy
traits.text: Always attacks with disadvantage.

actions.name: Punt
actions.text: 1d12+10. On hit, Prone & Knockback Primary Die spaces.

flavor: The smallest of giantkin; foul-tempered, petty, and deeply insecure about appearing foolish. Found commonly roaming the countryside, devouring livestock, and acting as hired muscle for Goblins, Bandits, and especially Gnolls.

tactics.easier: Punt Ranged heroes away to safety. Play into their stupidity, attack suboptimal targets (whichever is making the most noise, whichever hurt him last).
tactics.harder: Use Punt to separate heroes and kick them toward allies.

name: Hill Giant (GM Guide)
flavor: Mighty brutes and cunning beasts, always on the lookout for easy prey.

name: Hivedriver Bug

traits.name: Distress Call
traits.text: When attacked, summon a Bug Minion.

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: 2d4+8. On crit: move a Bug Minion.

flavor: These bugs live long enough to grow to the size of a wagon and become a living hive. KILL ON SIGHT.

name: Hollow Knight

traits.name: Hollow One
traits.text: Cannot crit or be crit (ignore any additional dice/effects that happen when crit).

actions.name: Doomblade
actions.text: 1d10+10 (Req: DC 12 WIL save to Interpose). On damage, 1 Wound.

flavor: A Grave Squire that dies in service to his master is sometimes raised as a Hollow Knight.

tactics.easier: Focus on front line heroes who don't rely on crits or additional modifies for their damage.
tactics.harder: Use your speed to focus on back line heroes and classes that need crits or modifiers to deal extra damage.

name: Hollow Tyrant

traits.name: Undead
traits.text: The first time this drops to 0hp, reset to 30 hp.

groupTraits.name: Eye HATE you!
groupTraits.text: When crit with Piercing or Slashing, attacker rolls 1d20 instead of any other dice. Immediately use 1 ray.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.text: (Reach 10, save DC 17) roll 2d6 or choose twice:

actions.name: Warping Ray
actions.text: 2d6+10, Dazed and exchange places with target.

actions.name: Petrification Ray
actions.text: 2d4+10, on crit: permanently Dazed (healing ends; 3 stacks, Petrified).

actions.name: Charm Ray
actions.text: Force an enemy to move then make 2 basic attacks; move and 1 attack on a WIL save (this does not spend their actions).

actions.name: Death Ray
actions.text: 2d20+10 damage, 1 wound, half on STR save.

bloodied.text: (130hp). Immediately use Warping Ray.

flavor: Made immortal through ancient and forbidden magics, these tyrants retain their intelligence in undeath, but become more and more paranoid as the ages pass.

name: Hookspawn

traits.name: Lacerated
traits.text: Suffer 1 damage for each space you move (or are moved). Healing or a DC 15 Examination check ends.

flavor: Its enormous scythe-like hooks prevent prey from fleeing.

tactics.easier: Target Ranged heroes who have little need to move.
tactics.harder: Lacerate as many heroes as possible. Combine with Glabrezu, Hezrou, or Incubus/Succubus to force movement.

name: Hordecaller Kerem

traits.name: Hordecaller
traits.text: When crit, summon 1 Flamebound Ancestor/hero (place them within Reach 6).

groupTraits.name: Battlelust
groupTraits.text: Heroes have disadvantage on Initiative against an Orcish band.

groupTraits.name: Tough as Nails
groupTraits.text: Orcs have Medium armor, except against magic damage.

actionsIntro: After each hero’s turn, Move 4 then choose one:

actions.name: Ancestors of Flame
actions.text: (If there are more heroes than Orcs) Use Hordecaller.

actions.name: Command the Horde
actions.text: (1/round) Command your horde to move then attack.

bloodied.text: At 125 HP "Ancestors, I call upon you!" Use Hordecaller.

lastStand.text: At 0 HP Kerem is dying! 100 more damage and he dies. Use Hordecaller at the end of each turn.

tactics.easier: Command the Horde when there are fewer Ancestors of Flame, and spread them out.
tactics.harder: Save Command the Horde until right after you summon more minions for max damage.

name: Howling Gale

traits.name: Turbulent Aura
traits.text: Half damage from Ranged attacks.

traits.name: Razor Winds
traits.text: On crit, +10 damage (instead of rolling additional dice).

actionsIntro: Choose twice:

actions.name: Slicing Gale
actions.text: (Reach 2) 2d4, treat the highest die as primary.

actions.name: Dizzying Vortex
actions.text: (Reach 2) Daze and Restrain in the air (damaging the elemental ends).

traits.name: Hidden Trap
traits.text: (2 uses) When an enemy would move adjacent to you, move them back 1 space, Restrain them (escape DC 14) and deal 2d8+8 damage.

tactics.easier: Allow melee combatants to close in on you, decline using your trap.
tactics.harder: Start combat positioned on high ground, move to a new position each turn to stay at long range.

traits.name: Hidden Trap
traits.text: (1 use) When an enemy moves adjacent to you, Restrain them (escape DC 10).

tactics.easier: Allow melee combatants to close in on you, decline using your trap.
tactics.harder: Start combat positioned on high ground, move to a new position each turn to stay at long range.

traits.name: Hidden Trap
traits.text: (1 use) When an enemy would move adjacent to you, move them back 1 space, Restrain them (escape DC 10) and deal 1d8 damage.

tactics.easier: Allow melee combatants to close in on you, decline using your trap.
tactics.harder: Start combat positioned on high ground, move to a new position each turn to stay at long range.

traits.name: Hidden Trap
traits.text: (1 use) When an enemy would move adjacent to you, move them back 1 space, Restrain them (escape DC 12) and deal 1d8+8 damage.

tactics.easier: Allow melee combatants to close in on you, decline using your trap.
tactics.harder: Start combat positioned on high ground, move to a new position each turn to stay at long range.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.text: Advantage VS damaged creatures.

name: Huskwalker
flavor: Crabmen reanimated by necromantic meddling. Sometimes they wash up on shore, mindlessly terrorizing anyone nearby.

tactics.easier: Attack any target that is closest. Move on to other targets after knocking Prone, or wander aimlessly is a undead haze.
tactics.harder: Crabmen can dog-pile a hero knocked prone by a Huskwalker, keeping them pinned with Grapple.

name: Hydra

traits.name: Uh, guys…
traits.text: Starts with 2 heads. Gain 1 additional head at 120hp, 90hp, 60hp, and 30hp.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: (Reach 3) 1d20 per head, you may split the damage dice among any creature in Reach. On damage, poisoned (healing ends).

flavor: Young hydras are captured and tamed through ritual using mist, drums, and pheromones. In peace, they are fed offerings—often trespassers. When one grows too large, the Lizardfolk deem it sacred, abandoning their village so the beast may rule the swamp.

tactics.easier: Spread the attacks out, or attack a Dying hero with all heads, it only counts as a single attack and is not likely to crit!
tactics.harder: Attack a single hero for devastating damage!

name: Ice Troll

traits.name: Regenerate
traits.text: Does not die at 0 HP. Only fire, radiant, or a crit while at 0 HP can kill it.

actionsIntro: Choose twice:
flavor: Known for their brutality and ravenous appetites, there is a long-running debate among scholars about whether Trolls are a type of giant Goblin, or a goblinesque Giant.

name: Imp

traits.name: Cowardly
traits.text: Advantage on attacks when an ally is adjacent, Disadvantage otherwise.

flavor: Cowardly opportunists, they strike whenever attention falters.

name: Incubus/Succubus

traits.name: Infernal Allure
traits.text: At the beginning of each round, Allure 1 hero on a failed DC 15 WIL save (you spend one of their actions this round). They gain advantage on the save for each time they fail this encounter.

flavor: Cruel tempters who use their allure to sew chaos and inflict pain.

tactics.easier: Target strong-willed heroes (Shepherd & Songweaver)
tactics.harder: Target weak-willed heroes (The Cheat & Shadowmancer)

traits.name: Infernal Allure
traits.text: At the beginning of each round, 1 hero is Allured on a failed DC 15 WIL save (you spend one of their actions this round). They gain advantage on the save for each time they fail this encounter.

traits.name: On Death
traits.text: Summon 1d8 spiderling minions.

name: Iron Goat

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.text: Cannot be moved against its will except by Large+ creatures.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text: 2d8. Knockback a number of spaces equal to the distance moved toward the target.

flavor: Their primary mode of dealing with predators (or heroes) is to knock them off a steep cliff.

tactics.easier: Knock heroes straight back and chase them down.
tactics.harder: Knock heroes off cliffs or into rocks for extra forced movement damage. Make them climb back up to reach you, then do it again!

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.text: Immune to being Hampered. Ignore any damage less than 10, reduce all damage taken to 10.

actions.name: Iron Grip
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d20, Grapple (escape DC 20). +1d20 for each round Grappled. Then:

bloodied.name: Mighty Leap
bloodied.text: (50hp) Immediately leap 12, knock creatures adjacent to where you land Prone. (1/round) You can use Iron Grip as a reaction when a creature would enter or leave your Reach.

name: Iskaryth the Frostborne

traits.name: Rimeblade Aura
traits.text: (Reach 2) Others suffer 2 damage for each space they move while in this area.

traits.name: Shielded by Ice
traits.text: Vulnerable to Fire and Bludgeoning damage, she gains advantage on her next attack.

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, Fly 12 OR choose one:

actions.name: Icewall
actions.text: (1 use, Reach 10) Summon a wall of ice 5 spaces in a line.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Move 3. (Reach 2) 2d6+10. On damage, Frostbite: Can't use Reactions (healing or fire damage ends).

actions.name: Shattering Claws
actions.text: Move 3. (Reach 2) 3d6. Any die can be chosen as the primary die against a Hampered target. On crit: deal +20 damage instead of rolling additional dice.

actions.name: Blizzard
actions.text: (1 use, AoE, Reach 6) 3d6+20. DC 14 STR save or frozen in place (Restrained, save to escape, or any Fire/Bludgeoning damage).

bloodied.name: Brutal Storm
bloodied.text: At 95hp summon a icy storm, others are Blind beyond Reach/Range 6 and take 1d6 damage at the end of each of their turns.

lastStand.text: Iskaryth is dying! 80 more damage and she dies. Brutal Storm intensifies: 2d6 damage instead.

flavor: A name whispered in reverence and fear among the highland tribes and northern scholars alike. She slumbers beneath the ruins of Skeldrim Hollow, a shattered temple buried in ice, guarded by frost-wights who chant in dead tongues. But recent tremors in the permafrost and the unnatural stilling of the wind have led some to believe she stirs again—awakened not by hunger, but by prophecy. They say when Iskaryth flies once more, she will not return alone.

tactics.easier: Iskareth can say "YOU ALL WILL BE BITTEN BY FROST!" and spend a few turns flying with Biting each hero "WHO'S NEXT?", greatly reducing her damage output (and allowing the heroes to RP and try to deceive her or heal through the Frostbite and catch up). Return to the normal tactics when you feel the heroes have regained the upper hand.
tactics.harder: Regain Blizzard once when Dying and increase the DC to 16 (or they must deal 16 Bludgeoning or Fire damage). Instead of a straight line, you can use Wall of Ice to completely encircle a hero!

name: IT That Hurls THE STONE

traits.name: STONE, Armor & Weapon
traits.text: While IT holds THE STONE, IT has Heavy Armor.

groupTraits.name: Overwhelming Stench
groupTraits.text: When rolling initiative VS Troglodytes, make a STR save instead.

groupTraits.name: Death Stench
groupTraits.text: On death: Troglodytes Poison adjacent enemies for 1 round.

actionsIntro: After each hero’s turn, pick 1 (alternate):

bloodied.name: Reek Aura
bloodied.text: At 65 HP creatures who start or end their turns within Reach 3 must make a DC 12 STR save or take 5 psychic damage and their choice of Poisoned or Dazed for 1 round.

lastStand.name: Somehow Worse On the Inside!
lastStand.text: IT is dying! 40 more damage and IT dies. Until then, the DC of Reek Aura increases to 14 and the Reach 4.

name: Jabberwocky

traits.name: Mad Babbling
traits.text: Initiative is a WIL save instead. 1-9: the Jabberwocky can make you perform 2 actions this round, 10-19: 1 action (this does not spend any existing actions).

actionsIntro: Choose twice:

actions.name: Eyes of Flame
actions.text: (Reach 12, max 1 target). 2d10. Target takes this damage again at the end of their turn until extinguished (if the Jabberwocky is crit, water is used, or spending an action dropping Prone and rolling ends).

bloodied.text: At 120 hp use Mad Babbling again, all heroes roll with disadvantage.

flavor: Jabberwockies are false dragons that babble incessantly, drawing in their prey with a maddening allure. Gazing too long into its eyes is said to reveal both the true shape of the world, and the incomprehensible horror in the space behind it.

tactics.easier: Use actions from Mad Babbling to move Heroes randomly, and attack each other. Use Claws That Catch more often.
tactics.harder: Use actions from Mad Babbling to set up attacks for other monsters, such as Bogeys and Nixies, and to attack or interpose against each other. Use Jaws that Bite more often.

name: Jacker Bug

traits.name: Hijacked
traits.text: (1/round) when able, you must Interpose for your Hijacker for free (healing ends).

groupTraits.name: Swarming Pheromones
groupTraits.text: At the end of each round: non-minion bugs summon a Bug Minion.

flavor: When stung, every drop of blood in your body bends towards protecting your toxic captor until you die.

tactics.easier: Attack first, allowing heroes to easily Defend. Foreshadow the effects of the Toxin (via an NPC or Naturecraft checks).
tactics.harder: Attack with them last, after a hero has already Defended or attack in pairs to get damage through.

name: Justiciar

traits.name: Infernal Edict
traits.text: When damaged by the Justicar, enemies MUST accept the next Offer they receive. Enemies suffer 5 damage whenever they act while it is not their turn.

groupTraits.name: Fiendishly Crafty
groupTraits.text: A crafty fiend reveals only the benefits of the Offer and NOT the drawbacks—though if a hero insists, you may reveal all the terms.

flavor: Judges of Fiendlaw with enormous, gaping maws. They bellow judgements toward foes, forcing them into terrible deals.

tactics.easier: Limit the need to Interpose by spreading damage out and attacking more well-armored heroes.
tactics.harder: Focus-fire weak heroes, force their allies to Interpose. Tempt them into making Opportunity Attacks against weak enemies. Use Cruel Judgment to to set up devastating Offerings for the Hierarch, Lashfiend, or Pactmonger.

name: Kelebek, Entomancer
actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose Kelebek OR Poppy to act (rec. alternate).

actions.name: Vinelash
actions.text: Move 6, then 2d6. On damage, move target to an unoccupied space within Reach 6.

bloodied.text: When Kelebek is bloodied, Poppy always Interposes for him. Both roll 3d6 instead.

lastStand.name: Noxious Gas
lastStand.text: When Poppy dies, all heroes have a max of 2 actions each turn.

name: Knight

traits.name: Defender of the Realm
traits.text: (1/round, Reach 4) Can Interpose for allies.

flavor: Honorable and well-trained, even a single knight is a dangerous foe.

tactics.easier: Interpose for lower damage allies, especially vs crits that ignore your heavy armor.
tactics.harder: Interpose for stronger allies, especially vs attacks with modifiers that your Heavy armor can easily mitigate.

name: Knight Dragoon

traits.name: Dismounted
traits.text: At 0hp summon a Knight, Prone.

actions.name: Lance
actions.text: (Reach 2) 1d8+20. +1 damage for each space moved toward target.

flavor: Fearsome warriors who act as one with their steeds to cover lots of ground swiftly.

tactics.easier: Stay close to heroes so that Lance has a lesser effect.
tactics.harder: Hit and run. Charge in to attack then move away to build up another big Lance attack.

name: Kobold

groupTraits.name: Nooooo!
groupTraits.text: Whenever an ally within Reach 2 dies, attack once for free.

flavor: A loyal friend and a tenacious enemy. Unthreatening… until they're surrounded by friends!

tactics.easier: Attack from Range, and stay spread out.
tactics.harder: Keep them close together to maximize Nooooo!

name: Kobold (GM Guide)

traits.name: Nooooo!
traits.text: When an ally within Reach 2 dies, attack for free.

flavor: Small, maniacal dragonlings. Fiercely protective of their own.

flavor: Scarred veterans of countless cave wars, Champions are the strongest and most ruthless warriors among the Troglodytes. They wield jagged weapons of obsidian, bone, or rusted metal scavenged from fallen adventurers. They lead warbands on surface raids at night and are considered chosen of The Deep Rot, the profane Deep Titan.

tactics.harder: The only armored Troglodyte! Use them at higher levels to increase the challenge level without too greatly multiplying the number of monsters. Remember to keep the ratio of monsters to heroes no higher than 4 to 1 (minions excluded) for typical encounters.

name: Troglodyte Muckthrower

groupTraits.name: Overwhelming Stench

groupTraits.name: Death Stench
groupTraits.text: On death: Troglodytes Poison adjacent enemies for 1 round.

flavor: Brew globs of toxic sludge from cave rot, bile, and fermented remains. They lob pungent globs that burn and blind, fouling the air with stomach-turning potency. They’re also key in preparing the pungent brew that powers Swollen Ones.

tactics.harder: Further debilitate foes, adding the Blinded condition gives the Trogs an additional instance of advantage against the Heroes.

name: Troglodyte Screecher

traits.name: Remember!
traits.text: AoEs do not miss or crit, and ignore armor. Dazed creatures cannot be Dazed again.

groupTraits.name: Overwhelming Stench
groupTraits.text: When rolling initiative VS Troglodytes, make a STR save instead.

groupTraits.name: Death Stench
groupTraits.text: On death: Troglodytes Poison adjacent enemies for 1 round.

flavor: These are both living alarm systems and battlefield disruptors, born with oversized lungs and sensory organs. Their unholy cries reverberate through caves, disorienting foes, and alerting kin. They are revered as “Voice of the Depths” in certain cults.

tactics.harder: Greatly increase the survivability of the Trogs, and if positioned well can output as much damage as Champions. There is no need to have Screechers in an encounter that also has a Swollen One, their effects are redundant and can't be combined.

name: Troglodyte Swollen One

groupTraits.name: Overwhelming Stench
groupTraits.text: When rolling initiative VS Troglodytes, make a STR save instead.

groupTraits.name: Death Stench

actions.name: Throw

actions.name: Pervading Stench

flavor: The apex of Troglodyte hierarchy, these foul and corpulent shamans are religious leaders who radiate a miasma so foul it can collapse the mind and curdle the blood. Their bodies are swollen and warped with tumors and glands that excrete sacred reeking fluids, that can command the hive's unwavering loyalty. They wear robes stitched from cured hide—often from their own disobediant kin.

tactics.harder: These should act first, to help position Trogs deeper into the heroes' back lines, as well as to reduce the actions the heroes can take and their effectiveness by Dazing and Poisoning them. Trogs should mercilessly attack any who approach their revered Swollen Ones.

Equipped with ever-growing claws or chitin-tipped tools harvested from monstrous bugs, these brutes can bore through soil and even solid rock, ambushing prey from below. Their rumblings echo through stone, sowing fear long before a raid.

tactics.easier: Avoid burrowing again, act as a regular Troglodyte.
tactics.harder: Should always act first to set up advantaged attacks for their smelly comrades.

actions.name: Chaaarrge!

actions.name: Itchy Fleas

flavor: Vermis is more than a nuisance, he's a menace! And that rat Skittersnack is a bad influence at best. Vermis rides through town at all hours, yelling obscenities and stealing anything he can't eat. Even worse, Skittersnack has started developing a following... of fleas! It's high time someone stopped the duo's reign of terror.

name: Vesha, the Beauty

flavor: Depending on when and how you meet her, Vesha may appear a shriveled and hideous crone, or the fairest maiden in the land. This primordial hag drains the beauty from those whose appearances she covets, softening and de-aging her own features. But her efforts are ultimately futile. Her cruel and covetous nature corrupts any fair looks she attains, and within mere days she becomes uglier than before.

actions.name: Bow Before Me!
actions.text: Each hero rolls 3d20. Allow each to bow (become Prone) or take that much damage.

bloodied.name: BLEED WITH ME!

lastStand.name: Your Pain Will Be Unending!

flavor:

No records tell of when Vorgrath first took the throne; some say he has always sat upon it. Commander and Lord of all fiends, he demands fealty and endless tribute from his progeny. Those that fail are ripped asunder without a second thought.

Conqueror of the black depths, his goal now is to rise and conquer the world beyond the White Gate, spreading his hate and poison to the farthest corners of the known lands and beyond.

tactics.easier: Use his "Serve Me!" to move the heroes around rather than attack one another. Have him land after using "Suffer!" action, perhaps demanding fealty again, to allow the heroes to attack from melee if they dare! Lacerated could end after 1 round.
